insights.one_liner: Global energy company with big Dutch offices; IND sponsor posting English-language entry roles mainly in Rotterdam, with 100+ nationalities on Dutch staff.

culture.text: In the Netherlands, 9,380 employees of more than 100 nationalities work for Shell (March 2024).
Staff often studied mechanical or chemical engineering, business or computer science, with TU Delft and Imperial College among top schools.
Open jobs here are mostly entry-level (7 of 9), centred on Rotterdam, with some also listing Pernis, The Hague and Amsterdam.

open.text: Shell International B.V., Shell Nederland B.V. and Shell Asset Management Company B.V. are IND recognised sponsors.
All 9 of its jobs here are open to non-Dutch speakers.

growth.text: 2023 revenue was USD 316.62 billion with net profit of USD 19.638 billion and about 90,000 staff.
Took the final investment decision to double LNG Canada's export capacity.

worth_knowing.text: The future of Shell's Moerdijk chemicals site is open: selling, splitting up or closing are all being discussed.
Shell Nederland has a new president-director, Thomas de Boer.
Shell is building a pilot in Amsterdam for more efficient e-SAF (synthetic aviation fuel) production.
